svg.text: Group meeting about the presentation tomorrow
Completed tasks move here 30 days after completion. They keep every field, and Restore puts them back where they were.
A completed task stays in its lists for this long before it moves to the Archive.
Show archived tasks in Smart Lists
Changing this never deletes anything; it only moves the line between here and the lists.
Archived tasks are kept, not deleted.
They keep their task text, tags, priority, summary and dates.
Restore puts one back into the lists it would qualify for today.
Deleting a task is a separate, explicit action on the task itself.
Group meeting about the presentation tomorrow
Pick up shift timesheet from boss today
A list you cannot trust is worse than no list, and a list that quietly loses finished work is one you stop trusting.
So completed work goes somewhere you can see it, with the date it was finished and the date it moved.
